recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast monochrome central portrait of a figure in a chainmail-style top, overlaid with a 'dripping liquid' texture and punctuated by small, square, full-color photographic insets showing close-up details like eyes, lips, and jewelry.
coreVisualRelationships: Monochrome background vs. high-saturation color insets
Fluid, organic liquid drips vs. rigid geometric square frames
Large-scale central figure vs. small-scale detail fragments
Bold, horizontal typography bisecting the vertical composition
coreInvariants: High-contrast black and white base image

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central figure occupies the upper two-thirds of the frame, scaled to a medium-close shot.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure's torso and the horizontal text line acting as a belt-like divider.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the central face, follows the vertical drips down to the text, then orbits the square insets scattered around the perimeter.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant white space at the bottom third provides a clean base for the lower insets and balances the busy upper half.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Grayscale (Black, White, Silver) for the main subject and background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Natural skin tones and warm golds within the square insets.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted blue and terracotta within the typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast in the monochrome areas; moderate saturation in the small focal points.
paletteRestrictions: Limit primary colors to the text only

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family with color shifts to distinguish words.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the weight and 90s editorial feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white photo of a person in a metallic mesh top. Apply a semi-transparent overlay of white liquid drips running vertically. Place 4-5 small, perfectly square color photos of close-up details (eye, lips, hand with ring, cross) in a scattered but balanced arrangement around the subject.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of bold, uppercase geometric sans-serif text across the middle. Use a muted blue for the first half and a terracotta brown for the second half. Ensure letters are tightly spaced.

verificationChecks: Is the main image strictly monochrome?
Do the liquid drips look vertical and fluid?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Check that text is legible against the background
Ensure color insets are vibrant compared to the B&W base
Verify the 'drip' effect doesn't obscure the face
Confirm the composition feels balanced despite the scattered elements
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochrome Subject + Liquid Overlay + Square Color Insets + Bold Bi-Color Sans-Serif Typography
